title: Leora & Lynn, Toddler on Porch Balustrade - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical black-and-white snapshot with decorative deckled edges featuring a smiling young woman seated on the wooden balustrade of a residential front porch, holding a toddler on her lap. Strong afternoon sunlight illuminates their faces and casts bold shadows on the porch steps and shingled exterior wall behind them. The young woman wears a floral summer dress, socks, and woven sandals with her hair styled in mid-1940s rolls. The front lower white margin is inscribed in ink, 'Leora and Lynn'.
